content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: BHEL Trichy has issued the Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Batch 2 notification on 21 November 2026 for 214 apprenticeship training vacancies. The walk-in drive will begin on 25 November 2026 for Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Amendment Act, 1973. The available trades and disciplines include Fitter, Welder, Instrument Mechanic, COPA and Mechanical Engineering. Candidates should read the official notification to understand the eligibility criteria, stipend, age limit, document requirements and walk-in instructions. content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BHEL Trichy has announced 214 apprentice vacancies across Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentice categories. The Trade Apprentice category has the highest number of vacancies at 166, including 77 Welder, 50 Fitter, 34 COPA and five Instrument Mechanic positions. The remaining vacancies include 22 Technician Apprentices and 26 Graduate Apprentices in Mechanical Engineering. Reservation for apprenticeship engagement will be followed according to applicable Government guidelines. The Batch 2 notification does not provide a separate category-wise vacancy breakup.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before attending the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026, candidates should check whether they meet the required educational qualification, age limit, passing-year and apprenticeship registration conditions. Eligibility differs for Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentices. Candidates must also satisfy the restrictions regarding previous apprenticeship training and work experience. Yes, freshers with the prescribed ITI, Diploma or Mechanical Engineering Degree qualifications can attend the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026, provided they meet the age, marks, passing-year and registration requirements. Prior work experience is not required. However, candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training or have one year or more of work experience are not eligible under the notification. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide and does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should verify their qualifications, category requirements and registration status against the official BHEL notification before attending the walk-in drive.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must meet the category-specific educational qualifications and other conditions prescribed in the Batch 2 notification. The recruitment includes ITI Trade Apprentices in four trades and Technician and Graduate Apprentices in Mechanical Engineering. Candidates applying for Trade Apprentice positions must have completed full-time regular ITI training in the relevant trade. For all trades except Welder, an NCVT or SCVT certificate is required. For the Welder trade, only an NCVT certificate will be considered. The notification does not prescribe a minimum ITI percentage, but candidates must have passed their respective trades. For Technician Apprentice positions, candidates must possess a full-time regular Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a Government-recognised institution. UR, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates must have secured at least 60% marks, while SC and ST candidates need at least 50% marks. Only candidates who completed their Diploma in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 are eligible. Candidates applying for Graduate Apprentice positions must have completed a full-time regular Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a Government-recognised institution or university. The minimum marks requirement is 60% for UR, OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates and 50% for SC and ST candidates. Eligible candidates must have completed their Engineering Degree in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The BHEL Trichy Apprentice age limit is calculated as on 1 November 2026. For the Welder trade, candidates must be between 14 and 27 years old. For all other trades and disciplines, the prescribed age limit is 18 to 27 years. Eligible reserved-category candidates can claim relaxation in the upper age limit according to the notification. BHEL Trichy provides upper age relaxation for eligible SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and PwD candidates as specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates under BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly stipend according to their apprentice category and trade. The highest stipend is Rs.12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices, followed by Rs.10,900 for Technician Apprentices. Trade Apprentices will receive Rs.10,560 or Rs.11,040, depending on the trade. Note: These amounts are monthly apprenticeship stipends, not permanent employee salaries. The apprenticeship engagement is for one year, and completion of training does not guarantee employment with BHEL.

Candidates should report during the specified hours with the required educational certificates, identification documents and apprenticeship registration details. The closing date of the drive will be published separately on the official BHEL Trichy website.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive must bring the documents specified in the official Batch 2 notification. These documents are required to establish educational qualifications, category eligibility and apprenticeship registration status. Class 10 marksheet for candidates applying under the Welder trade. Class 10 marksheet for all candidates. Consolidated marksheets of the prescribed ITI, Diploma or Degree qualification. Aadhaar Card. Community Certificate for applicable OBC, SC, ST or EWS candidates. Disability Certificate for eligible PwD candidates. NAPS registration for Trade Apprentice candidates. NATS 2.0 registration for Technician and Graduate Apprentice candidates. Candidates should ensure that their apprenticeship registration has been completed on the appropriate portal before attending the walk-in drive.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice NAPS and NATS Registration 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive must be registered on the relevant Government apprenticeship portal. Trade Apprentice candidates must use the NAPS portal, while Technician and Graduate Apprentice candidates must register through the NATS 2.0 portal. NAPS Registration for Trade Apprentices NATS 2.0 Registration for Technician and Graduate Apprentices

content_sections.heading: How to Attend BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must attend the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive in person at the notified venue. The recruitment notice requires candidates to have the appropriate apprenticeship portal registration and to bring the prescribed documents. Visit the official BHEL Trichy website at trichy.bhel.com. Download and read the Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026-27 Batch 2 notification. Check the trade or discipline, educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility requirements. Complete NAPS registration if applying for a Trade Apprentice position. Complete NATS 2.0 registration if applying for a Technician or Graduate Apprentice position. Prepare the required educational certificates, marksheets, Aadhaar Card and applicable category certificates. Visit the Human Resource Development Centre, HPBP, BHEL Trichy, from 25 November 2026 onwards during the notified hours of 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM. Present the required documents and follow the registration and selection instructions provided at the walk-in venue. Important: Candidates should check the official website for updates on the closing date before travelling to the walk-in venue.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Batch 2 notification announces a walk-in drive for the engagement of apprentices. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualification, marks, age, passing-year and registration conditions. The notice also specifies the documents required for the walk-in process. The notification does not provide a detailed written examination pattern, interview marking scheme or merit calculation method. Candidates should follow the instructions issued by BHEL Trichy during the walk-in selection process and any subsequent official updates.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Training Duration and Facilities 2026
content_sections.text: The BHEL Trichy apprenticeship engagement will be for one year. During this period, selected candidates will receive the prescribed monthly stipend for their trade or discipline. The official notification also states that subsidised food and hostel facilities are available. Employment Condition: BHEL has clearly stated that completion of apprenticeship training does not create an obligation for the company to provide employment. Apprentices cannot claim a right to permanent employment solely on the basis of completing their training.

content_sections.heading: Who Is Not Eligible for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies certain restrictions on apprenticeship eligibility. Candidates should review these conditions before attending the walk-in drive to avoid unnecessary travel or application-related difficulties. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in another establishment under the applicable Apprentices Acts. Candidates who are currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates who have completed a postgraduate qualification, including an integrated postgraduate course. Candidates having work experience of one year or more. Technician and Graduate Apprentice applicants who completed their relevant full-time Diploma or Degree outside the prescribed passing years of 2022 to 2026. Candidates who do not meet the educational qualification, age or minimum marks requirements applicable to their trade or discipline.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Details
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can attend the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive beginning on 25 November 2026. The walk-in venue is the Human Resource Development Centre, HPBP, BHEL Trichy. Candidates should complete their NAPS or NATS registration, as applicable, and carry the required documents. The closing date will be published separately by BHEL Trichy. BHEL Trichy Official Website - Walk-in Update

faq.question: Q1. When will the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026 begin?
faq.answer: There are 214 vacancies: 50 Trade Apprentice - Fitter, 77 Trade Apprentice - Welder, 5 Trade Apprentice - Instrument Mechanic, 34 Trade Apprentice - COPA, 22 Technician Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering, 26 Graduate Apprentice - Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for BHEL Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification states that the closing date of the walk-in drive will be published separately on the BHEL Trichy website. Candidates should check the official website for the confirmed closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BHEL Trichy Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time regular ITI qualification in the relevant trade. NCVT or SCVT certificates are accepted for eligible trades, but Welder applicants must possess an NCVT certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BHEL Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 14 to 27 years for the Welder trade and 18 to 27 years for all other trades and disciplines as on 1 November 2026. Applicable upper age relaxation is available for eligible reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for BHEL Trichy Apprentices in 2026?
faq.answer: Trade Apprentices will receive Rs.10,560 or Rs.11,040 per month depending on the trade. Technician Apprentices will receive Rs.10,900 per month, while Graduate Apprentices will receive Rs.12,300 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Can freshers attend the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible freshers can attend the walk-in drive if they meet the prescribed educational qualification, passing-year, age and registration requirements. Candidates with previous apprenticeship training or one year or more of work experience are not eligible.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the BHEL Trichy Apprentice Walk-in Drive?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the prescribed marksheets, Aadhaar Card, applicable community or disability certificates, and NAPS or NATS registration details. The official notification provides the document requirements for each apprentice category.

faq.question: Q9. Does BHEL provide permanent employment after apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: No. The apprenticeship training duration is one year. BHEL has stated that completion of apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment or give apprentices a right to claim employment with the company.
